data_fields.name: yield_priority
data_fields.donor_constant: 0 (a current clip at priority 0 is replaced by any request)

data_fields.name: clip_duration
data_fields.donor_constant: sum of frame delays; frame delay 0 falls back to the frame's delay, then to 1

data_fields.name: locomotion_slots
data_fields.donor_constant: 7 (ready, turn-on-spot, walk forward, walk back, walk left, walk right, running)

data_fields.name: request_delay
data_fields.donor_constant: script argument passed through unchanged; client unit not read

best_idea: A per-actor clip arbiter for one tick: a request replaces the current clip only if its priority is strictly higher, a priority-0 clip yields to anything, a protect flag refuses every request, and the slot clears at cleanup so arbitration is per tick only.
decision_why: The strict-greater, same-tick rule lets a hit reaction beat an attack swing requested in the same tick, but the donor has no lock across ticks, so the duel state machine (rows 1 and 3) must hold stagger and recovery.
acceptance: A server test submits an attack clip (priority 5) and a hit-reaction clip (priority 9) in one tick and asserts the reaction is written to the snapshot, an equal-priority pair keeps the first request, and the next tick starts with an empty slot.
